name: twist turn lift
description: A floor core move that combines a twist with a leg or torso lift. It works the abs and obliques through rotation.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and arms extended.
Lift your shoulders and legs off the floor.
Twist your torso and bring your knees toward one side.
Turn back through the centre and lift again.
Repeat to the other side, keeping the movement smooth and controlled.
